verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail stores scanned customer mail, so whether that data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack has no AI-training policy, opt-out control or data-use commitment. The related security controls (opting out of mail scanning, 2FA, shredding, signing a HIPAA BAA) are adjacent features and do not address AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
